lastAnalysis.notes:
session 1 recap (pasted from the group chat)

Brakka: Held the bridge, troll ran off, kept the goblins in line till the watch took them. Won two in the pit, lost the third to the champ — worth it.

Wick: bro rode an ox into a troll fight, lost my dagger to the river, got told the troll works for a "Toll King" 💀 also lost the party's 40g rigging dice (in my defense i was GOOD at it), Steve the ox lost a race by sitting down, and I got banned from a pie tent. 10/10 session, no notes

Maren: maren recap: rooted 3/4 goblins in place with entangle, healed brakka back up, thorn-whipped the last goblin into the burning railing (troll noped into the river lol), then patched up the surrendered goblins anyway bc soft heart. cinderford was cozy - sold out of honey, got 2nd place in the bake-off with a lavender honey loaf, and adopted a stable cat 🐈 steve the ox is now emotionally attached to me

Tovin: Tovin's night: torched a troll, lost my pit bet, and apparently 'read very well' by a woman who wants a year of my dreams for some king's secret. Also I may have quietly tidied up a loose end on the bridge — don't ask Luz about it.

Luz: Tonight Luz heal Brakka full HP after the troll fight (Cure Wounds clutch 😅), and she catch Tovin killing a goblin that was surrender, not happy about that at all. Then Ember Festival was so pretty, Luz lead the dawn blessing at the temple and whole square kneel, I nearly cry lol ✨

GM: the troll was WAY out of their league (hill troll vs lvl 3s) and they still drove it off. next session: the Toll King. rules q for next time - can Wick ride Steve as a mount without Mounted Combatant? also someone owes me pizza money

entry.name: Verdant Snare

mechanics.effect: When you cast a spell that uses plant magic or thorn magic to restrain or damage a creature, you can use your reaction to extend the effect. If the spell targets multiple creatures, you can choose one additional creature within 5 feet of a target to be affected by the restraining or damaging portion of the effect, even if it was not originally in range or targeted.

lineage.rationale: Maren demonstrated a specific tactical application of primal plant magic, using entangle to root enemies and thorn magic to finish them off, showing a refined control over vegetation in combat.

entry.system_equivalent: Druidic feature or feat enhancing plant control spells (Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition (2024 rules))

entry.name: Compassionate Mender

mechanics.effect: When you use a healing spell or a Medicine check to treat a wounded creature, if the target is an ally or a surrendered enemy, they gain temporary hit points equal to half the amount of hit points they regained (rounded down). This reflects the stabilizing effect of Maren's calm and caring demeanor.

lineage.rationale: Maren consistently healed allies and even treated surrendered enemies, demonstrating a deep commitment to care and healing that goes beyond simple mechanics, providing a stabilizing effect.

entry.system_equivalent: Passive healing bonus or feature (Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition (2024 rules))

evidence: Maren placed second in a bake-off with a lavender honey loaf

entry.name: Honeyed Artisan

mechanics.effect: You gain proficiency in the Craft (Cooking) skill. When you succeed on a Craft check to create food or drink, you can use your bonus action to create a small amount of honey or a simple baked good. These items can be sold for a higher price than usual, or used to gain a +1 bonus to Persuasion checks when interacting with creatures who appreciate fine food.

lineage.rationale: Maren demonstrated skill in baking and selling honey, showing a talent for artisanal food preparation and commerce that can be leveraged for social and economic benefits.

entry.system_equivalent: Craft proficiency and social bonus feature (Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition (2024 rules))
